verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere documents an official CLI, Wally. It has concrete subcommands (`wally account whoami`, `wally account usage`), browser-based sign-in that hands the credential to the terminal, and the same CLI runs local models offline or hosted models when asked. Releases are published on GitHub. Community crash and install reports concern the separate rcli voice demo, not Wally's documented capability, so they do not create a dispute. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the Wally CLI, a complete documented command reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Check it with `wally account whoami`, and see what you have spent with `wally account usage`.
the same CLI runs it, offline and without an account.
The browser opens, you approve the request, and the terminal receives its credential.
